requirements.title: Neovim presentation host beyond terminal text
requirements.remaining: Internal renderer lifecycle integrated; web compatibility orchestration and non-web renderer validation remain. Conformance C1 completed frames/stable tab identity and C2 explicit-grid mouse/tab input have scoped macOS unit/live/desktop/package evidence, including both browser adapters and a combined CUA review. C3 nested command lines, UTF-8 caret/completion, highlighted output, dialogs and retained message bounds pass focused/default source and default packaged cases. The interrupted native focus-delivery race is fixed with failing-before/passing-after assertions; full native packaged integration now passes. The focused shutdown error popup was a test-tracer destroyed-object exception; fixed tracer/bootstrap now pass focused source and package with exit 0. Scoped C3 macOS acceptance is complete across sequential runs (STATUS), not a single full-package rerun. Prompt groups now resolve through the bridge with scoped linked-group/redefinition source evidence (ADR 0038); broader display/event fidelity remains in C4. C3 screenshot and combined nested-command/message interaction review passed (STATUS). Initial native-popup control and later link-readiness timeouts remain unexplained despite subsequent passing source/package runs. Linux attention and custom Jusi tabline overflow remain unresolved; Neovim 0.11.4 native overflow truncation is documented separately. C4a whole Unicode cells/continuations and explicit rendered columns pass focused/default source and packaged editor cases; the installed UI event inventory is complete. A shared pending cursor-projection cache race now has failing-before/passing-after tests for both adapters. Package lanes pass across sequential runs after isolated Neovim test state; historical native history/click failure attribution remains unproven. Combined manual review completed (queue 0/3), with native input AX-click handoff inconclusive and retained as a follow-up; automated focus/typing passes. See STATUS. C4b underline variants/strikethrough, cursor style disablement and completed-frame busy suppression are implemented with scoped unit/source display evidence (STATUS); command-line ownership hides the editor cursor. Prompt group resolution now passes unit, focused live UI and full default Electron acceptance with stale-reply/failure fallback (ADR 0038). Scalar UI options now have completed-frame state, incompatible-capability diagnostics and real second-UI detach/recovery coverage (ADR 0039). Normal negotiation is retained: override=true activated unrequested tabline/wildmenu on 0.11.4 and was removed. No visible recovery or legacy fallback; secondary UIs must be compatible. Font/spacing/blend/mouse preferences are classified but not newly applied. Blink timing/lifecycle and opaque highlighted block glyphs now pass unit and source desktop acceptance (ADR 0040). Combined packaged CUA decoration/prompt/cursor review passed; manual queue 0/3. Language-map/focus styling, preference consumption and remaining version/platform acceptance remain. Browser Unicode-click timeout was traced to an unavailable mirror before hit testing; the DOM fixture now validates its current mapping ticket instead of relying on old caret paint. Default desktop passes; no production interaction bypass introduced (STATUS). The bounded keyboard editor workflows pass source and packaged Neovim 0.11.4 on macOS arm64, including split scrolling, Unicode caret placement, wrapped commands/messages and completion (2026-11-18 STATUS).

requirements.title: Optional non-blocking text representation with visible completion
requirements.remaining: Shared mapping now includes Neovim-resolved exclusive/reversed and ordinary rectangular selections in both adapters. Block dollar-motion, partial terminal cells, complex grapheme/bidi/cross-node and layout/shadow/frame coverage, and end-to-end performance gates remain. Isolated Chromium timing and wrapped-range optimization are recorded; 8 ms slices are not uniformly achieved and default host-renderer timing trials now pass, while Unicode publication/paint cost and broader performance acceptance remain open. Shared visible cap reporting, atomic rejection, retry and rich-input recovery now pass both adapters in development; packaged evidence is recorded in STATUS. Reading controls and anchored/batched refresh pass scoped both-adapter tests; real YouTube, incremental updates, durable rewrap anchors and textless/custom control coverage remain open. Pause/manual/resume, statusline readiness and clipped accessibility labels now have development and packaged both-adapter workflow evidence; real-site replay and arbitrary clipping remain. Ctrl-P now redraws a Neovim-owned Text paused label before guest mutations, including late readiness/manual refresh precedence; headless and both-adapter rendered source checks pass (STATUS).

requirements.title: Persistent login, devices and custom certificates
requirements.remaining: Default horizontal popup splits retain exact Session/opener with scoped macOS development/package evidence. Real OAuth, packaged/Linux profile management/restart, per-origin permissions, media/devices and certificates remain open.

requirements.title: Common clean-close and rich/text navigation commands
requirements.remaining: Shared mode keys and reload/history/zoom have both-adapter keyboard evidence. The cancelled-chord focus assertion now allows intentional native parking, with delayed-acknowledgement packaged regression coverage. Earlier packaged refresh-focus timeout remains unexplained. Other rich accelerators, cross-tab focus races, full zoom/DPI coordinates and real IME conformance remain. Reading controls and anchored/batched refresh pass scoped both-adapter tests; real YouTube, incremental updates, durable rewrap anchors and textless/custom control coverage remain open. Current-document link/history, Cmd/Ctrl-click and Ctrl-N tabs, URL copying, close and pending-layout rich-entry pass the new both-adapter development/package workflows. Current URL names now have both-adapter macOS source/package and combined manual evidence (ADR 0042); W5 Cmd-Tab stale-modifier recovery now has both-adapter source/package and real OS evidence, plus actual YouTube DOM playback/link review (ADR 0043). W4 document fullscreen now has both-adapter macOS source/package lifecycle acceptance and actual YouTube fullscreen-only CUA evidence (ADR 0044, STATUS), including the Escape key-up forwarding regression. Broader input/platform conformance and W2 (last per user direction) remain open. Per-document detached DevTools command/F12 passes both adapters in macOS source and scoped package workflows (ADR 0045); manual and Linux acceptance remain. On 2026-10-31 the user reports fullscreen exit and unintended YouTube tabs recur. They remain unresolved; opt-in normal-session traces now cover routing, owner/restoration state and user markers. Immediate Ctrl-P pause status has both-adapter rendered source acceptance; see STATUS. No real-site fix or new manual acceptance is claimed. User-confirmed Ctrl-O lost-release incident now uses current trusted mouse flags rather than retained keyboard state; both-adapter source/package focused acceptance passes (ADR 0050, STATUS). Real-site replay and recurring fullscreen diagnosis remain open. Native text/status refresh no longer parks unchanged retained browser views: real-site before/after and source/package stability/focus tests pass (ADR 0051, STATUS). Final real-site manual review timed out at navigation and remains open. The marked fullscreen trace recorded host-toggle dispatch during document fullscreen, but did not establish the physical chord. Shared F11/Ctrl-Command-F priority now passes unit regression and both-adapter source/package fullscreen workflows (2026-11-02 STATUS, ADR 0044); real-site replay after restart remains pending. Ordinary video exit was subsequently reproduced with a second DOM webview: Electron sibling exit propagation windowed the host. Explicit coordinator ownership of native window transitions now passes F/Escape/double-click/button cases with no OS exit event in both source and packaged adapters, plus broader check and default package smoke (2026-11-05 STATUS, ADR 0044). User real-site replay and Linux acceptance remain pending.
